title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: CultPass App Not Opening
content:
If a user reports that the CultPass app won't open:

- Ask them to force close and reopen the app
- Suggest restarting their device
- Check if there's a pending update in the app store
- If issue persists, recommend clearing app cache
- For continued problems, direct to support team

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try force closing the app and reopening it. If that doesn't work, restart your device. Also check if there's an update available in your app store. If you're still having trouble, we can connect you with our support team."

title: Troubleshooting App Performance
content:
If a user reports slow performance or crashes:

- Ask them to check their internet connection
- Suggest clearing the app cache and data
- Recommend updating to the latest version
- For persistent issues, advise uninstalling and reinstalling the app
- If problem continues, escalate to technical support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"First, ensure you have a stable internet connection. Try clearing the app cache, and make sure you're running the latest version. If issues persist, we may need to reinstall the app or connect you with our technical team."

title: Managing Notification Settings
content:
Users can customize notification preferences in the app:

- Navigate to 'Settings' > 'Notifications'
- Options include push notifications, email alerts, and in-app messages
- They can toggle each type on or off based on preference

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can manage your notification settings by going to 'Settings' > 'Notifications' in the app. Here, you can choose which types of alerts you'd like to receive."

title: Refund Policy Overview
content:
CultPass offers a 7-day money-back guarantee on all subscriptions.

- To request a refund, users must contact support within 7 days of purchase
- Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days
- No refunds are issued for individual experiences or partial months
- For premium events, separate refund policies may apply

**Suggested phrasing:**
"We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact us within a week for a full refund to your original payment method. This does not cover individual experiences or partial months."

title: Contacting CultPass Support
content:
Users can reach out to CultPass support through multiple channels:

- Within the app: 'Help' > 'Contact Support'
- Email: support@cultpass.com
- Phone: +1 (800) 555-4567
- Social media: @CultPass on Twitter and Instagram

Support hours are Monday-Friday, 9AM-6PM EST.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can contact us through the 'Help' section in the app, email us at support@cultpass.com, or call us at +1 (800) 555-4567. Our team is available Monday-Friday from 9AM-6PM EST."

title: Understanding CultPass Premium Experiences
content:
Premium experiences are special events that offer enhanced access or exclusive content:

- Usually require an additional fee beyond the standard subscription
- May include VIP seating, meet-and-greets, or backstage access
- Details and pricing are displayed in the app before reservation
- These events are often limited in availability

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Premium experiences offer exclusive access or enhanced perks like VIP seating or meet-and-greets. These events usually have an extra cost and limited spots available. All details are shown in the app before you reserve."

title: How to Provide Feedback or Report an Issue
content:
Users can submit feedback or report issues directly through the app or via email:

- In-app: 'Help' > 'Submit Feedback'
- Email: feedback@cultpass.com
- Include details about the issue, steps to reproduce, and screenshots if possible
- For urgent matters, use the 'Report Issue' option in the app

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can share feedback or report issues through the 'Help' section in the app or by emailing feedback@cultpass.com. Please include as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce the issue."

title: Privacy Policy and Data Usage
content:
CultPass is committed to protecting user privacy:

- We collect only necessary information for account creation and experience management
- User data is encrypted and stored securely
- We do not sell personal information to third parties
- Users can request data deletion at any time via 'Settings' > 'Privacy'
- For detailed information, refer to our full Privacy Policy on the website

**Suggested phrasing:**
"We collect only what we need to provide the CultPass experience. Your data is encrypted and never sold to others. You can request deletion of your data at any time through the app's privacy settings."

title: How to Update Profile Information
content:
Users can update their profile details through the app:

- Go to 'My Account' > 'Edit Profile'
- Update fields such as name, email, phone number, and address
- Changes take effect immediately
- For sensitive information like payment details, users should contact support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To update your profile, go to 'My Account' and select 'Edit Profile'. You can change your name, email, phone, and address here. For payment information, please contact our support team directly."

title: Troubleshooting Payment Issues
content:
If a user encounters payment problems:

- Verify card details and expiration date
- Confirm sufficient funds or credit limit
- Check if the card is supported by CultPass
- Try a different payment method
- For recurring issues, escalate to billing support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please double-check your card details and ensure you have sufficient funds. If the issue continues, try using a different payment method. If you're still having trouble, we can connect you with our billing team."

title: Account Recovery Process
content:
If a user forgets their password or loses access to their account:

- Direct them to the 'Forgot Password' option on the login screen
- They will receive an email with recovery instructions
- If they don't receive the email, check spam/junk folder
- For account takeover concerns, recommend contacting support immediately

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If you've forgotten your password, tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. You'll receive an email with recovery steps. If you don't see it, check your spam folder. For security concerns, please contact support right away."
